EXPLAIN DOMINATION in terms of a negative shadow price.

ESTIMATE the shadow price implied by a dispute between F and E partisans. It will be negative. That is, the price is better than free; you can have more tons at no loss in score. If a store selling cookies offered to give you a bag and also a dollar, would you take the deal? Of course.
